description: Blocks browser automation against the my.helloretail.com Supervisor and dashboard pages. Dashboard reads and writes go through the hello-retail MCP; the only sanctioned my.helloretail.com navigation is the login preflight's read-only probe of the root URL.

hooks.command: IN=$(cat); if printf "%s" "$IN" | grep -qiE "my\.helloretail\.com[^\"]*(supervisor|company)"; then echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"BLOCKED: my.helloretail.com Supervisor/dashboard pages are off-limits to browser automation. Use the hello-retail MCP for all dashboard reads/writes. The only sanctioned my.helloretail.com navigation is the login-preflight probe of the root URL.\"}}"; fi
